_comment: The sequence of waves for one survival run. 'question_source' names which content/*_questions.json bank the interstitial after that wave draws from ('spot_it' | 'explain_it' | 'compare_it' | 'matapono_maori' | 'confusable_pairs'). Each bank is shuffled once per run and drawn from in order, so a bank used across two waves (e.g. spot_it in waves 1 and 2) never repeats the same question within a run. The last wave is the boss: 'confusable_pairs' is used as a rapid two-question gate (see QuestionInterstitial.gd) rather than a single question, and enemy_type 'boss_glitch' is tougher than the regular 'glitch'.
